doc.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18

title: The Moon tonic: formula, demonstration and Darensbourg as head chemist
summary: The tonic was about 60 percent alcohol with grenadine, Epsom salt and soap; Doc demonstrated shaving and lathering with it.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: what was the medicine?
What was it called? Moon tonic. Moon tonic. Moonshine.
Moon tonic. Well, it was, well, you could say moonshine, all right, and you'd be pretty close to it.
But I, this, this is, this is some real great medicine. Uh, after I was with the show about six or seven weeks, I worked up to what you would more or less say as a head came in.
Oh, no,
no kidding.
What did that, what did that involve? Well, that involved mixing, mixing the formula there.
Yeah, what was the formula?
Well, uh, I wouldn't like to give you the exact formula because, uh, I might, uh, you might start using it again, manufacturing it, uh, but anyway,
you all go places with you.
Well, yeah, it, it would be a good deal. As close as I can, we, uh, we had, uh, some, uh, uh, alcohol, uh, grenadine syrup.

Well, this, uh, we had, uh, some alcohol, and Doc, uh, had some special things, because, I imagine it's called vitamins, vitamins in these days. Uh-huh. Incidentally, that's the only thing that's keeping me now from, uh, putting this stuff on the market. I can't exactly remember all that was in it. Uh-huh. But they had some, uh, Epsom salt, grenadine syrup for the coloring because it was red. Uh-huh. about 60% alcohol.
Wow. Soon it gets you high, huh?

Yeah. And, uh, some kind of a, a formula, or I think, uh, it would take your green soap, because this is all purpose medicine, you must remember. You could shave with it, and you could bathe with it, and shampoo, and everything. That's no kidding.

Doc would give you a demonstration on the stage. What kind of demonstration? Well, he'd, he'd, he'd on, cork a bottle, and pour some out, out of his hand, and then lather it real good, and put it on his face, and take a raisin pass across his face, and show you, you could shave with it.
Then he'd douse his hair, and everything,
and form like hell. It's form?
Yes, sir.
And you also drank this?
Yes, sir.
Why certainly?
Did you ever drink this?
That made it such a great medicine. Why certainly?

Once in a while, I was drinking, why certainly? It would make you feel, it would make you feel good. It's like taking a good shot of whiskey. Even better. It would clean you out real good. Yeah? It really would.
And,
we had a lot of people that did a lot of repeats. I mean, you know, I swear by that medicine. The only thing Doc had to watch out for, the thing he guarded most was the labels.
